messages:
incident-bot: ALARM: sustained 5xx spike for org=LumenArc → ~800% above baseline. Alert INC-4632 created and paging oncall rotation. Tripped org-level circuit breaker and auto-throttles applied to org traffic.
marie: ack, I'm looking. LumenArc hitting eu-west-1 endpoints, spike started ~16:22 UTC. Lots of retries from their worker fleet.
tariq: I'm oncall — tagging in. @marie can you paste a few example error logs? need to understand whether it's our infra or client retries.
marie: sample error: "KV cache miss overflow" across multiple hosts, followed by client retry bursts. Baseline ~120 rps, current ~1.2k rps with ~25% 5xx. Live log tail: https://internal/logs/INC-4632 (redacted).
samir: quick triage: looks like a client-side batch job hammered their keyspace. Two safe mitigations: 1) surgical per-org rate override (raise qps+burst briefly) to let in-flight work finish, 2) feature-gate embeddings/large calls for that org to cut load. Prefer (1) if customer insists it's critical.
elaine: ops chiming in — embeddings are expensive here. If they can't pause the job we'll need to disable embeddings for LumenArc for a few minutes. We also need a TTL on any override.
tariq: agree. marie, please apply a temporary override with TTL 15m and monitor. Set burst so backlog can drain, but keep global caps in place. Post the command when you run it.
marie: executing now.
marie: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://internal-admin.redwood/api/v1/orgs/LumenArc/overrides"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"qps":2400,"burst":4000,"expires_at":"2027-03-01T16:40:00Z","reason":"ephemeral spike - emergency adjust"}'
```
ops-bot: Override applied: id=ovr-7892 by marie. Scope=org:LumenArc. Effective immediately. TTL=15m.
kevin: monitoring metrics — after override, ingress rps down to ~900 and 5xx dropped to ~7% within 60s. P95 latency stable. Looks like it's doing what we hoped.
samir: nice. filing short-term action items: 1) customer note asking them to pause their batch, 2) follow-up runbook to add automatic fallback gating for embeddings on error spike. Creating RFC: RF-881.
tariq: I'm going to assemble a quick incident summary for the handoff. Handoff to night oncall @elaine at 16:45 UTC unless we see regression.
marie: summary saved to INC-4632: temporary org override ovr-7892 applied (marie), reason: client retry storm; revert scheduled 2027-03-01T16:40:00Z; customer notified to pause batch; follow-ups: RF-881, org-spike runbook update.
elaine: ack — I'll monitor and will revert earlier if safe. Leaving watch for the next 20m. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Update INC-4632: override ovr-7892 expires at 2027-03-01T16:40:00Z. Next auto-check scheduled 16:38 UTC. If metrics remain stable post-expiry, system will auto-revert.
